phase_7.title: Phase 7 · Disconnector Handoff & Sear Reset

zh.headline: 柯尔特 SAA 1873 “和平缔造者” 单动左轮：1873 年机械传奇与工程剖析
zh.deck: 1873 年定型的柯尔特单动陆军型（SAA，“和平缔造者”）是人类金属定装弹左轮手枪的永恒丰碑：闭合整框机匣赋予其远超前代火帽左轮的结构强度，拇指拉锤时著名的四声清脆机械咔哒声（“C-O-L-T”）成为十九世纪工业机械交响。 本馆以 1:1 真实工程比例重现其 20 大核心构件与完整工作循环。

acts.title: 时代召唤与研发立项：Colt SAA 1873 的诞生背景
paragraphs: 1873 年问世的 柯尔特 SAA 1873 “和平缔造者” 单动左轮 由美国柯尔特专利武器制造公司（Colt’s Patent Fire Arms）主导研制，定位为经典的整框侧门装填单动转轮手枪。作为 1873–1892 年美国陆军制式骑兵手枪，柯尔特 SAA 赢得“征服西部之枪”美誉，一百五十余年来至今仍在柯尔特工厂持续限量手工生产。
1873 年定型的柯尔特单动陆军型（SAA，“和平缔造者”）是人类金属定装弹左轮手枪的永恒丰碑：闭合整框机匣赋予其远超前代火帽左轮的结构强度，拇指拉锤时著名的四声清脆机械咔哒声（“C-O-L-T”）成为十九世纪工业机械交响。 整件装备总长 279 mm（11.0 in · 4.75 in 枪管型）、空重 1.048 kg，成为同期手枪左轮领域最具辨识度的里程碑之一。
acts.audioScript: 第一幕，时代起源。1873 年，美国柯尔特专利武器制造公司（Colt’s Patent Fire Arms）推出了划时代的柯尔特 SAA 1873 “和平缔造者” 单动左轮。作为 1873–1892 年美国陆军制式骑兵手枪，柯尔特 SAA 赢得“征服西部之枪”美誉，一百五十余年来至今仍在柯尔特工厂持续限量手工生产。 它的核心设计聚焦于闭合整框淬火彩色机匣配六发开槽转轮，彻底告别脆弱的开口火帽框架，奠定了其在手枪左轮发展史中的经典地位。
acts.focusPartLabel: 一体式重型锻钢转轮框桥

acts.title: 核心机械构造与闭锁奥秘
paragraphs: 柯尔特 SAA 1873 “和平缔造者” 单动左轮 的机械灵魂在于其「纯单动手动压锤四声咔哒棘轮 · 整框右侧装填门 + 顶壳杆」结构体系。在发射工作循环中，扣动扳机联动拨轮棘爪精准转动转轮巢室并与枪管轴线刚性锁止对齐，将高压能量精确约束于承力框架之内。
制造工艺方面，关键承力件采用发蓝锻钢与油润精选胡桃木/桦木托精加工而成。手拉击锤时依次发出四声清脆定位咔哒（保险、半待击装弹、转轮锁定、满待击），在严苛实战条件下依然保持顺畅节拍与长期尺寸稳定性。
acts.audioScript: 第二幕，核心机械原理。柯尔特 SAA 1873 “和平缔造者” 单动左轮 采用纯单动手动压锤四声咔哒棘轮 · 整框右侧装填门 + 顶壳杆。在每个击发周期中，扣动扳机联动拨轮棘爪精准转动转轮巢室并与枪管轴线刚性锁止对齐。借助发蓝锻钢与油润精选胡桃木/桦木托工艺与高强度配合，实现了手拉击锤时依次发出四声清脆定位咔哒（保险、半待击装弹、转轮锁定、满待击）。
acts.focusPartLabel: 转轮闭锁止动块与弹底挡板

acts.title: 弹道性能、内膛工艺与实战效能
paragraphs: 该平台配用 .45 Colt (11.4×33mmR) 弹药规格与 121 mm（4.75 in 烤蓝圆形枪管 · 6 条左旋 · 1:406 mm），最高工作膛压约 97 MPa，可赋予弹头 260 m/s 的出膛初速与 555 J 动能，有效作用距离达 45 米。
内膛技术特点方面，121 mm 柯尔特传统 6 条左旋膛线，发射 255 格令重型圆头 .45 Colt 铅弹。同时，机匣右侧开启式装填门 + 枪管下方弹簧退壳杆实现经典逐发装退弹流程，令其在 24 发/分（单动压锤与逐发退壳） 的节奏下兼具精准控制与可靠输出。
acts.audioScript: 第三幕，弹道与实战表现。配备 121 毫米身管与 .45 Colt (11.4×33mmR) 口径，柯尔特 SAA 1873 “和平缔造者” 单动左轮 实现了每秒 260 米的初速与 45 米有效射程。121 mm 柯尔特传统 6 条左旋膛线，发射 255 格令重型圆头 .45 Colt 铅弹，展现了卓越的工程平衡。

acts.title: 人机工效、供弹哲学与百年遗产
paragraphs: 围绕 6 发容量的凹槽式多发旋转弹巢（转轮）与 44 mm 膛轴设计，柯尔特 SAA 1873 “和平缔造者” 单动左轮 将单发后坐冲量控制在 4.5 N·s 水平。标志性“犁柄式”（Plowhandle）核桃木握把在后坐时顺势滚转吸收冲击。
如今在数字兵器库 3D 百年展厅（BAY-89）中，您可以随时通过三轴剖视、100% 爆炸视图与实时运动学滑块，零距离拆解这座跨越时代的机械工程杰作。
acts.audioScript: 第四幕，百年遗产。凭借 6 发容量的凹槽式多发旋转弹巢（转轮）与出色的整体工效，标志性“犁柄式”（Plowhandle）核桃木握把在后坐时顺势滚转吸收冲击。欢迎在 BAY-89 展位亲手切开剖面、逐件拆解，感受 柯尔特 SAA 1873 “和平缔造者” 单动左轮 的机械魅力。

acts.title: Origins & Operational Mandate of the Colt SAA 1873
paragraphs: Introduced in 1873 by Colt’s Patent Fire Arms Mfg. Co. in United States, the Colt Single Action Army 1873 “Peacemaker” emerged as a defining Solid-Frame Single-Action Revolver. Issued to US Cavalry from 1873 to 1892 as “The Gun That Won the West,” the Colt Single Action Army remains in continuous collector production over 150 years later.

Adopted by the US Army in 1873, the Colt Single Action Army “Peacemaker” married a closed solid steel frame to metallic .45 Colt cartridges, rotating its six-chamber cylinder through the celebrated four-click manual hammer arc with a side loading gate and under-barrel ejector rod. Measuring 279 mm (11.0 in · 4.75 in Barrel) at an unloaded weight of 1.048 kg, it reshaped expectations across the Handgun class.
acts.audioScript: Act One: Historical Origins. In 1873, Colt’s Patent Fire Arms Mfg. Co. of United States introduced the Colt Single Action Army 1873 “Peacemaker”. Issued to US Cavalry from 1873 to 1892 as “The Gun That Won the West,” the Colt Single Action Army remains in continuous collector production over 150 years later. Anchored by its hallmark design trait — Closed solid case-hardened frame delivers rugged strength over earlier open-top revolvers — it quickly established an enduring engineering benchmark.

acts.title: Core Operating Architecture & Lockup Mechanics
paragraphs: At the mechanical heart of the Colt Single Action Army 1873 “Peacemaker” sits its Four-Click Single-Action Hammer & Hand · Solid Frame Loading Gate & Ejector Rod. Throughout every firing cycle, trigger and hand pawl index the fluted cylinder cleanly into locked alignment with the forcing cone, containing 97 MPa of operating pressure safely.

Constructed in blued forged ordnance steel paired with oil-finished walnut, the assembly achieves durable field tolerances. Notably, Manual hammer arc clicks through four iconic mechanical notches (“C-O-L-T”), sustaining dependable operation under severe environmental stress.
acts.audioScript: Act Two: Core Mechanical Architecture. The Colt Single Action Army 1873 “Peacemaker” relies on Four-Click Single-Action Hammer & Hand · Solid Frame Loading Gate & Ejector Rod. During each cycle, trigger and hand pawl index the fluted cylinder cleanly into locked alignment with the forcing cone. Machined from blued forged ordnance steel paired with oil-finished walnut, it delivers standout engineering reliability: Manual hammer arc clicks through four iconic mechanical notches (“C-O-L-T”).

acts.title: Ballistic Performance, Bore Craft & Range Reach
paragraphs: Chambered for .45 Colt (11.4×33mmR) with 121 mm (4.75 in Blued Round Barrel · 6-Groove LH · 1:406 mm), the Colt Single Action Army 1873 “Peacemaker” develops 260 m/s muzzle velocity and 555 J of kinetic energy for effective engagement out to 45 meters.

Internally, 121 mm traditional Colt 6-groove LH rifling stabilizing heavy 255-grain .45 Colt bullets. Combined with its 24 RPM (single-action manual cycle) tempo, Right-side hinged loading gate and spring-loaded ejector rod cycle shells individually, delivering disciplined accuracy across demanding field conditions.
acts.audioScript: Act Three: Ballistic Performance. Driving .45 Colt (11.4×33mmR) through its 121 millimeter bore, the Colt Single Action Army 1873 “Peacemaker” achieves 260 meters per second and 45 meters of effective reach. 121 mm traditional Colt 6-groove LH rifling stabilizing heavy 255-grain .45 Colt bullets.

acts.title: Feed Philosophy, Ergonomics & Centennial Legacy
paragraphs: Fed by a 6-round fluted revolving cylinder with a 44 mm bore-axis height, the platform manages 4.5 N-s of recoil impulse cleanly. Curved “plowhandle” walnut grip rolls naturally in the palm to absorb .45 Colt recoil.
